_comment: Pinned bootstrap manifest. Every value here was READ FROM THE WORKING
DEVELOPMENT MACHINE, not chosen from documentation: sizes and SHA-256
digests were computed over the files this product actually runs on, and
every URL was probed with an HTTP Range request and confirmed to serve a
byte count identical to the local file.
DO NOT bump anything here because a newer version exists. The stack is
pinned to what is verified working. See lab/setup/README.md.

why: ctranslate2 4.8.1, onnxruntime 1.23.2 and piper-tts 1.6.0 wheels are
resolved for this interpreter. The machine's system default was 3.14.3
and was DELIBERATELY not used -- the ML wheel ecosystem does not
publish for it, and the resulting install failures were misread as

min_driver_basis: CUDA 12.4 minimum driver for Windows. The llama.cpp build pinned below
is the CUDA 12.4 one and reaches sm_120 through PTX JIT -- verified by
`llama-server.exe --list-devices` enumerating the GPU, and by the
product running. NOTE: lab/reports/ENVIRONMENT.md section 7 concluded
the CUDA 13.3 build was 'the only viable official prebuilt'. That
conclusion is SUPERSEDED by the working 12.4 build; the 13.3 archive
is still on the dev machine at lab/bin/llama but is not what ships.
gpu.vram_required_basis: E0 frozen gate: measured peak 6745 MB with Whisper int8_float16 co-resident; smoke measures 4469 MB peak at current HEAD.

_comment: ⚑ FOUND BY TESTING, not anticipated. A fresh venv created under a long
path installs all 44 packages successfully and then fails to import:
sounddevice  -> OSError ... libportaudio64bit.dll: error 0xce
onnxruntime  -> ImportError: DLL load failed ... The filename or
extension is too long.
Windows LoadLibrary resolves DLL dependencies against MAX_PATH even when
HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\FileSystem\LongPathsEnabled is 1 --
verified: that flag IS 1 on the development machine and the imports still
failed at a 192-character venv root.
The production tree sits at a 103-character venv root, worst case 247 of
260 -- THIRTEEN characters of headroom. A user whose account name is a
little longer, or who unpacks one folder deeper, lands on an error
message nobody could act on. Hence the preflight check.

disk._comment: final = venv 2.30 GiB + llama124 extracted 1.08 + gemma 4.80 + two piper voices 0.12 + whisper 1.51. Required leaves room for the retained zips and pip's wheel cache during setup.

hf_snapshots.label: faster-whisper large-v3-turbo (CTranslate2)
why: `large-v3-turbo` in app/config.py is an ALIAS that faster-whisper 1.2.1
resolves to this repo. Recording the alias alone would not be
reproducible, because the alias target can change between library
versions -- which is why the library version is pinned too.
Downloaded through huggingface_hub, which verifies its own digests;
the pinned revision is what makes it reproducible.
